title: Sturdy Cycles Ditches 3D Printing for the New Fosse and Drove Titanium Bikes
content:
The Somerset-based manufacturer is rolling out new road and gravel bikes at Rouleur Live along with a pivot to CNC-machined components and simplified sizing.

Read the full article at Sturdy Cycles Ditches 3D Printing for the New Fosse and Drove Titanium Bikes on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
